figures.finding: From 2023 the employer pays a single insurance contribution of 30% on pay up to the single annual base limit (RUB 2,979,000 in 2026, Government decree No. 1705 of 31 October 2025) and 15.1% above it (art. 425); a self-employed person on the professional income tax (NPD) pays 4% on income from individuals and 6% on income from businesses and companies, with no insurance contributions, while income stays within RUB 2.4 million a year.

figures.finding: An author or performer paid royalties (for creating or performing literary and artistic works) may deduct documented expenses or, without documents, a set share of the fee: 20% for literary works (theatre and film writing included), 30% for audiovisual works (films, television), 20% for performing literary and artistic works, 40% for film and theatre design and for film music.
